comments.body:
Experiment progress (Copilot CLI session, worktree filter-exp @ origin/main).

Harness built in git-ignored .expscratch/: common.py (corpus/AC parse/reduction), prepack.py (deterministic per-AC evidence packs: backtick+identifier+path token grep at ref, file_impact slices, referencing commits via git log --grep, cited-test function listings; 6KB/AC cap, thin-pack-on-missing, never synthesized), filter_pass.py (ONE boto3 Bedrock converse call, us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, temp 0, PASS-with-citations-or-ABSTAIN contract, FAIL coerced to ABSTAIN), run_verify.py (in-process verify_completion, source=local fetch=false, mock.patch.object on rebar._reads.show_ticket for description override/AC reduction + completion_verdict_cache.cache_dir to a per-run scratch dir).

EMERGENT FINDING 1: the completion verifier has a deterministic 8000-char description ADMISSION CAP — my first corpus (4ee2 iced-oniony-crustacean 11009ch, 850f loft-teeth-zip 10446ch) fast-FAILed 'description is N chars; accepts at most 8000' in ~1s, and a 45c1 adversarial edit that GREW the description to 8054 tripped it too. Any real corpus ticket must be <=8000 and adversarial edits length-neutral. Corpus reselected: 45c1 barky-metalled-bettong (task, 7998ch, 6 ACs), 3388 disparaged-parodistic-shrew (story, 7892ch, 10 ACs), 0e68 outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast (epic, 7707ch, 7 ACs, 14 children — the with-children case). Adversarial variants: 45c1 ACs 0+3, 3388 AC 6, 0e68 ACs 2+5 rewritten to reference symbols proven absent at ref (MODULE_SPLIT_REGISTRY, legacy_reexports, merge_conflict_bodies/body_merge.py, NullProjectRouter, bridge migrate-projects).

Filter-pass results (6 calls, 5-19K tokens each): 45c1-real PASS 0/6; 45c1-adv PASS 1/6 (the genuinely-met trailer AC), both edited ACs ABSTAINED; 3388-real PASS 9/10; 3388-adv PASS 8/10 with the edited AC ABSTAINED; 0e68-real+adv PASS 0/7. FALSE-PASS COUNT SO FAR: 0. Coverage is strongly bimodal: ACs naming greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) can PASS from a static pack; ACs asserting runtime outcomes ('suites pass green', 'lint clean', 'second pass emits zero updates') or store-side artifacts (ticket comments) rationally ABSTAIN. 12 agentic runs (fallback+control per variant) now running sequentially.

comments.body:
## Experiment results: prepack single-pass FILTER + narrowed agentic fallback

Setup: throwaway harness in worktree `filter-exp` @ origin/main (git-ignored `.expscratch/`; no src/rebar changes; nothing pushed to Gerrit). Filter = ONE Bedrock converse call (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, temp 0, no tools) over ticket text + deterministic per-AC evidence packs (grep-at-ref for AC-named symbols/paths, file_impact slices, referencing commits via `git log --grep`, cited-test function listings; 6KB/AC cap; thin packs never synthesized). Contract: per AC, PASS-with-citations or ABSTAIN; FAIL forbidden (coerced). Fallback = the real agentic `verify_completion` (source=local, never signs) with the ticket's AC block REDUCED to the abstained ACs via a `unittest.mock.patch` of `rebar._reads.show_ticket`; verdict cache isolated per run by patching `completion_verdict_cache.cache_dir`. Control = same harness machinery, un-reduced ticket. Corpus: 3 real closed tickets (45c1 task 6 ACs, 3388 story 10 ACs, 0e68 epic 7 ACs + 14 children) + 3 in-harness adversarial variants with 1-2 ACs rewritten to reference symbols proven absent at ref.

### Metrics

| ticket (variant) | type | ACs | filter PASS / cov | false-PASS | filter tok(in/out) | fallback steps/tok(in)/wall | control steps/tok(in)/wall | combined vs control (in-tok) | verdict fb/ctl |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| barky-metalled-bettong (real) | task | 6 | 0 / 0% | **0** | 4766/310 | 17 / 832,111 / 103s | 17 / 841,510 / 103s | -1% | PASS/PASS |
| barky-metalled-bettong (adv) | task | 6 | 1 / 17% | **0** | 4863/338 | 19 / 877,032 / 91s | 15 / 691,226 / 88s | +28% | FAIL/FAIL |
| disparaged-parodistic-shrew (real) | story | 10 | 9 / 90% | **0** | 9951/1539 | 7 / 561,006 / 36s | 28 / 2,686,353 / 131s | -79% | PASS/PASS |
| disparaged-parodistic-shrew (adv) | story | 10 | 8 / 80% | **0** | 10367/1505 | 14 / 1,245,946 / 72s | 32 / 3,354,007 / 160s | -63% | FAIL/FAIL |
| outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast (real) | epic | 7 | 0 / 0% | **0** | 6109/412 | 32 / 1,723,537 / 225s | 37 / 2,274,302 / 261s | -24% | PASS/PASS |
| outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast (adv) | epic | 7 | 0 / 0% | **0** | 8305/562 | 55 / 3,350,295 / 280s | 35 / 1,852,161 / 277s | +81% | FAIL/FAIL |

TOTALS: combined 8.63M input tokens / 144 steps / 878s vs control 11.70M / 164 / 1020s (**-26% tokens**); real tickets only: 3.14M vs 5.80M (**-46%**). Total filter spend across all 6 calls: 49K tokens (~0.4% of control's agentic spend). Epic (0e68) reported with the with-children caveat: both arms traverse the 14 children identically; its +81%/-24% deltas are agentic run-to-run variance on IDENTICAL criteria sets (filter abstained all 7), not filter cost.

### Correctness (the survival criterion)
- **False-PASS count on adversarial unmet ACs: 0** — all 5 planted-unmet ACs (45c1: 2, 3388: 1, 0e68: 2) ABSTAINED at the filter and were FAILed by the fallback. Every real variant verified PASS/PASS; every adversarial variant FAIL/FAIL in both arms. False-positive rejection is impossible by construction and none occurred downstream of the filter on filter-PASSed ACs.
- No store writes beyond ticket comments; all 12 agentic runs source=local, signable=false; verdict caches isolated to per-run scratch dirs.

### Failure modes observed
1. **8000-char description admission cap** (deterministic fast-FAIL in verify_completion): killed the first corpus (11009ch and 10446ch tickets) and one adversarial edit that grew a 7998ch description to 8054. Adversarial edits must be length-neutral; any productized reducer must re-check the cap after reduction (reduction only ever shrinks, so it can also RESCUE an over-cap ticket).
2. **Coverage is bimodal by AC style, not ticket size**: ACs naming greppable artifacts (test functions, symbols, files) PASS from a static pack (3388: 90%); ACs asserting runtime outcomes ("suites pass green", "second pass emits zero updates", "lint clean") or store-side artifacts (ticket comments) rationally ABSTAIN (45c1, 0e68: 0%). Real-ticket coverage overall: 9/23 ACs = 39%.
3. **Filter coverage is context-sensitive**: 45c1 AC5 (commit-trailer AC, genuinely met, identical evidence pack) ABSTAINED in the real variant but PASSed in the adversarial variant — same pack, different surrounding ticket text. Temp-0 does not make the judgment stable across contexts.
4. **Agentic verifier variance dominates small deltas**: on identical criteria sets the agentic arm varied 35↔55 steps and in one 0e68-adv fallback run FAILed 2 genuinely-met ACs alongside the 2 planted ones (agentic false-FAILs — the exact pathology the operator predicted for pure single-pass, still present at low rate in the agentic verifier itself). Cost comparisons need variance-aware interpretation; ±30% single-run deltas are noise.
5. Prepack quality is the whole game: the first pack build (backtick tokens only) produced 100% abstention; adding identifier/path extraction + cited-test function listings unlocked 3388's 90%. Never-synthesize held throughout.

### Verdict: GO (conditional)
Filter+fallback beats pure-agentic on cost **with zero false PASSes**: -26% tokens overall, -46% on the real (all-met) corpus, and the filter's own cost is negligible (~0.4%), so the worst case is cost-neutral-within-variance while the best case (test-citing AC styles, exactly what the plan-review gate pushes authors toward) is a 60-80% saving. Recommend productizing as an optional pre-filter stage in verify_completion with: (a) the PASS/ABSTAIN-only contract enforced at the schema level, (b) the existing criteria-reduction seam (AC-block rewrite at ticket load) as the narrowing mechanism — it worked cleanly including epic child traversal and auto-narrowed the step budget, (c) filter-PASSed ACs recorded with their citations in the verdict for auditability, (d) coverage telemetry per AC style to decide when the filter call is worth making (skip it for tickets whose ACs are all runtime-outcome style). The residual risk to watch in production is not the filter (0 false PASSes here) but agentic false-FAIL variance, which this design narrows but does not remove.

compiled_state.description:
## Why
Operator direction (2026-08-15): approach viral-peppy-lowchen (b4be-0ed8-22cb-4b01) as an EXPERIMENT before any production design. Experience says a pure evidence-prepacked single-pass verifier yields false-positive REJECTIONS whenever the prepack is imperfect — and a perfect prepack over natural-language prose ACs is unrealistic. Operator counter-proposal to test: use the single pass as a FILTER that may only PASS or ABSTAIN per criterion (never reject), then run the existing agentic verifier scoped to the remaining criteria — narrowing agentic work, not eliminating it. Structural consequence: false-positive rejection is impossible by construction; the residual risks to MEASURE are false-positive PASSes and insufficient coverage (filter abstains so often it saves nothing).

## Protocol (rapid PoC — throwaway harness, no production code)
1. Corpus: select >=3 real CLOSED tickets with large surfaces (description near the 8000-char cap, >=6 prose ACs, comments; at least one with children), e.g. the tapeworm CLI-normalization ticket (7998 chars) and the bettong decomposition ticket. Ground truth for these = all ACs met (they passed the close gate). Add >=3 ADVERSARIAL variants: copies (in-harness, not written to the store) with 1-2 ACs edited to be genuinely unmet (reference a symbol/behavior that does not exist at the verified ref). Ground truth = those ACs unmet.
2. Prepack builder (harness script): per AC, deterministically assemble evidence — file_impact paths + their content slices, grep hits for symbols/strings the AC names, referencing commits + diffs, test names/results where cited. Cap per-AC pack size; record pack-build failures honestly (missing evidence -> thin pack, NOT a synthesized one).
3. Filter pass: ONE LLM call, no tools: given ticket text + per-AC packs, emit per AC either PASS(with citations) or ABSTAIN. The contract forbids FAIL.
4. Fallback: run the existing agentic verifier scoped to the ABSTAINed ACs via the ticket-load seam: `verify_completion` loads the root ticket through `_reads.show_ticket` (src/rebar/llm/completion.py:197); the harness monkeypatches that read (the standard unit-suite technique) to return the real ticket with its Acceptance Criteria block REDUCED to the abstained ACs. Criteria enumeration (`explicit_completion_criteria`, completion_criteria.py:45) and the step floor (completion.py:212-237, keyed on checkbox count) both derive from that text, so the budget narrows automatically — that IS the mechanism under test. Read-only --source local, never signs.
4b. Comparability: the pure-agentic control runs the SAME harness (same monkeypatch machinery, un-reduced ticket, same ref, same config) so fixed overheads cancel; the cost delta is reported as (filter LLM call + narrowed agentic run) vs (full agentic run), each with its own auto-derived floor. Child-closure/precheck asymmetries are avoided by corpus selection: childless tickets verify identically in both arms; the one with-children ticket is reported separately with this caveat stated.
5. Metrics table (the deliverable): filter coverage (%% ACs PASSed at step 3), false-PASS count on adversarial unmet ACs (MUST be 0 for the design to survive), agentic steps/tokens/wall-time for step 4 vs a pure-agentic control run of the same ticket, per-ticket totals.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Harness exists in the experiment worktree (throwaway; NOT pushed to Gerrit; no src/rebar changes).
- [x] >=3 real large closed tickets + >=3 adversarial variants run end-to-end through filter+fallback AND a pure-agentic control.
- [x] Metrics table posted as a comment on THIS ticket and on viral-peppy-lowchen: coverage, false-PASS count, cost deltas.
- [x] Verdict comment: does filter+fallback beat pure-agentic on cost WITHOUT any false PASS? Include failure modes observed and a go/no-go recommendation for productizing.
- [x] No store writes beyond ticket comments; no signatures minted (--source local only).
